name: erdembircan/battery-surf-bench
description: WordPress plugin that benchmarks battery drain by simulating real-world web surfing.

scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Fix the PHPCS findings PHPCBF can fix.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run the PHP unit tests with an HTML coverage report in coverage/.
scripts-descriptions.validate:container: Check the service container recipes without compiling them.
scripts-descriptions.build:container: Compile the service container into build/Services.compiled.php.
scripts-descriptions.vendor:production: Install the Composer packages the plugin ships, without the dev ones.
scripts-descriptions.vendor:development: Install every Composer package, dev ones included.
scripts-descriptions.archive:plugin: Archive the files .gitattributes lets through into dist/.
scripts-descriptions.check: Run every lint, type check and unit test, plus the chart and license checks. Builds run it first.
scripts-descriptions.stage: Compile the container and archive the plugin with its production packages.
scripts-descriptions.build:development: Check, then build the plugin with the dev-tools panel into dist/battery-surf-bench/.
scripts-descriptions.build:production: Check, then build the plugin without the dev-tools panel into dist/battery-surf-bench/.
scripts-descriptions.zip:development: Build the development plugin and zip it into zip/battery-surf-bench-development.zip.
scripts-descriptions.zip:production: Build the production plugin and zip it into zip/battery-surf-bench.zip.
scripts-descriptions.serve:development: Start the development site: watch build, Playground with the dev tools, live reload.
scripts-descriptions.serve:production: Build the production plugin and serve it on a fresh Playground site.
